text: Run any tool at a specific version instantly via mise exec/x without a permanent install
quote: The quickest way to run a tool at a specific version is mise x|exec

text: Install a tool and set it as the global default version with one command
quote: mise use --global node@26 # install node 26 and set it as the global default

text: Reads and is compatible with asdf .tool-versions files and idiomatic version files like .node-version
quote: mise is also compatible with asdf `.tool-versions` files and with idiomatic version files like `.node-version` and `.ruby-version`.

text: Install and run a tool directly from a GitHub repo/release
quote: mise exec github:BurntSushi/ripgrep -- rg --version

text: Automatically switches active tool versions as you move between project directories
quote: Once activated, mise can automatically switch between different versions of tools based on the directory you're in.

text: mise bootstrap provisions a fresh machine: OS packages, dotfiles, repos, macOS defaults, and services
quote: mise bootstrap sets up a whole machine from the same config: OS packages, dotfiles, repos, services, macOS defaults, and services, then your tools.

text: Loads per-project environment variables from mise.toml, .env files, and secrets, active only while in the project
quote: Per-project env vars from `mise.toml`, .env files, secrets, and shell commands. Set when you enter, gone when you leave.

text: Define and run project tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying
quote: Define and run project _tasks_ for building, testing, linting, deploying, and everyday development workflows.

text: mise watch automatically rebuilds/reruns tasks on file changes
quote: mise watch to automatically rebuild on changes—no configuration required, but it helps

text: Tasks can be written as standalone executable bash scripts instead of embedded in yml/json/toml strings
quote: the ability to write tasks as actual bash script files rather than inside yml/json/toml strings, which lack syntax highlighting and linting/checking support

text: Task/dependency builds run in parallel by default with no extra configuration
quote: building dependencies in parallel—by default, with no configuration required

text: MISE_SAFE=1 mode prevents project configuration from executing arbitrary code
quote: set MISE_SAFE=1 so that project configuration cannot execute code

text: Can restrict installs to tool versions released before a certain date or minimum age
quote: minimum_release_age = "7d"  # only install versions released more than 7 days ago

text: Automatically verifies Cosign/Minisign signatures, SLSA provenance, and GitHub attestations for aqua-backend tools
quote: For aqua tools, Cosign/Minisign signatures, SLSA provenance, and GitHub artifact attestations are verified automatically using mise's built-in implementation.

text: Backend used to install a tool can be overridden via MISE_BACKENDS_<TOOL> environment variables
quote: You can override the backend for any tool using environment variables with the pattern `MISE_BACKENDS_<TOOL>`

text: Provides an official mise-action for CI that installs mise and configured tools
quote: we provide a [mise-action](https://github.com/jdx/mise-action) that wraps the installation of mise and the tools

text: Config files are looked up hierarchically in parent directories and merged, with closer files taking precedence
quote: what is defined there overrides anything set in `~/src/work/mise.toml` or `~/.config/mise.toml`. The config contents are merged.

text: A single checked-in config file replaces scattered dotfiles, so setup is just git clone + mise bootstrap
quote: mise replaces them with one file that's checked in, so a fresh laptop is `git clone` and `mise bootstrap`

text: Missing tool versions are automatically downloaded and installed on first use
quote:
mise exec python@3 -- python
# this will download and install Python if it is not already installed

text: Shell activation (eval mise activate) sets up automatic PATH/env management
quote: eval "$(~/.local/bin/mise activate bash)" >> ~/.bashrc

text: Can install packages globally from npm registry (e.g. mise use --global npm:pkg)
quote: mise use --global npm:@anthropic-ai/claude-code

text: Prompts the user to trust untrusted project config files before executing them
quote: mise ~/my-project/mise.toml is not trusted. Trust it? [y/n]

text: Supports a shims mode that creates shims instead of modifying PATH
quote: mise activate --shims  # Creates shims instead of modifying PATH

text: Supports custom HTTP-backend tool definitions with per-platform URLs and checksums
Provides an official install script (curl mise.run) to bootstrap the mise CLI itself
quote:
curl https://mise.run | MISE_VERSION="$MISE_VERSION" sh
mise version | grep -q "^${MISE_VERSION#v} "
mise install

text: mise lock command supports --bump/--dry-run with JSON output for updating the lockfile
quote: MISE_SAFE=1 mise lock --bump --dry-run --json

text: Ships its own Homebrew implementation, installing formulae and casks without requiring Homebrew itself
quote: mise has its own Homebrew implementation, so it installs formulae and casks without requiring Homebrew.

text: Manages dotfiles as symlinks, copies, or templates with single-line edits
quote: Dotfiles as symlinks, copies, or templates, plus single-line edits

text: Can bootstrap remote hosts over SSH via mise bootstrap remote
quote: Remote hosts over SSH with `mise bootstrap remote`

text: Can install Python packages from PyPI via pipx as a backend
quote: Install black from PyPI via pipx

text: Run a defined task by name, e.g. mise run build
quote: You can then run the task with `mise run build`

text: Specific backends (e.g. asdf) can be disabled via settings
quote: mise settings disable_backends=asdf

text: Can install tools from many different registries in one config: npm, PyPI, GitHub releases, etc.
quote: Install claude-code from npm... Install black from PyPI via pipx... Install ripgrep directly from GitHub releases

text: GitHub and aqua backends give access to almost all programs published on GitHub
quote: github and aqua give you for example access to almost all programs available on GitHub.

text: Recommends and supports pinning tools to exact versions for reproducible environments
quote: We recommend pinning tools to specific versions so the environment is reproducible.

text: mise ls --current lists active tool versions and their config source for the current directory
quote:
$ mise ls --current

Tool   Version   Source

bun    1.2.20    ~/work/dashboard/mise.toml

text: Can set environment variables directly via CLI (mise set VAR=value)
quote:
$ mise set SOME_VAR=bar
$ echo $SOME_VAR
bar

text: Tasks can declare dependencies on other tasks (depends = [...])
quote:
depends = ["validate", "plan"]
run = "terraform apply -auto-approve"
